reply.emotion: professional and matter-of-fact, talking about a workplace
notes: While 'empresa' most commonly refers to a commercial company or business, it can also mean a daring undertaking or ambitious project.

senses.definition: A business organization that sells goods or services to make money.

examples.text: Trabaja en una empresa de tecnología en el centro.
examples.translation: She works at a tech company downtown.
examples.emotion: proud and settled, describing where someone works

senses.definition: A difficult or daring project or undertaking.

examples.text: Esa misión fue una empresa muy difícil para el equipo.
examples.translation: That mission was a very difficult undertaking for the team.
examples.emotion: reflective and impressed by the scale of the challenge

definitions: A business organization that sells goods or services to make money.
A difficult or daring project or undertaking.
